name: Zoram'gar Outpost
summary: On Ashenvale's western shore, Zoram'gar Outpost gives the Horde access to the Veiled Sea. The fortified beachhead watches the Zoram Strand and the threats rising from its waters and nearby depths.

sections.title: A Bastion on the Strand
sections.body: Zoram'gar Outpost holds the northwestern edge of Ashenvale, where the forest meets the sea. Night elf territory lies inland, and hazards wait offshore. Scouts, hunters, and shaman at the isolated camp track local dangers. Life there is an endless vigil: naga prowl the shallows, while cultists and primal horrors stir in Blackfathom Deeps, the subterranean cavern system down the shore.

sections.title: Strategic Importance
sections.body: Zoram'gar Outpost keeps flight connections to other Horde holdings: Splintertree Post, the Crossroads, and Thunder Bluff. Though small, the camp anchors Horde supply lines on Ashenvale's western coast.

faq.q: Why did the Horde establish Zoram'gar Outpost?
aliases: why did horde build zoram gar
faq.answer: The Horde established Zoram'gar Outpost to secure a foothold on Ashenvale's western shoreline. The camp monitors the Zoram Strand by sea and offers a defensible station against the aggressive naga along the coast.

faq.q: What threats does the outpost face?
faq.answer: Wrathtail naga slither across the Zoram Strand, posing an immediate threat. Twilight cultists and beastly horrors in the nearby temple ruins of Blackfathom Deeps are another constant danger.

faq.q: Where does the outpost connect via flight master?
aliases: where can i fly from zoram gar
faq.answer: Wind riders carry travelers by air across central Kalimdor from Zoram'gar Outpost, linking it to Splintertree Post, Sun Rock Retreat, the Crossroads, and Thunder Bluff, the tauren capital.

faq.q: What is the relation between the outpost and Blackfathom Deeps?
faq.answer: Blackfathom Deeps lies just north of Zoram'gar Outpost among shoreline ruins. Horde forces stationed at the outpost watch corruption seep from the flooded temple and send adventurers inside to oppose the cultists and their beast, Aku'mai.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can find your primary haven in northwest Ashenvale at Zoram'gar Outpost, with shelter, rest, and wind rider transport amid dangerous wilderness.
As an Alliance member, you face an entrenched Horde presence on Ashenvale's coast. Zoram'gar Outpost holds a dangerous supply foothold near night elf ancestral lands.
